title: Clerical Officer
description:

Post 2 & 3 starting end Sept / Start of Oct to 31/7 until 31/07/27.

The main duties and responsibilities are:

external.

a) Using effective oral and written skills to communicate effectively with a diverse range of

deadlines.
c) Effectively using Microsoft Office to prepare documents and respond to correspondence.

title: Customer Planner/Front of House
description:
Your new company
A leading and highly successful FMCG organisation is seeking to appoint an Administrator / Customer Planner to join its busy team. This organisation works with a portfolio of well-known consumer brands and prides itself on delivering exceptional service to customers across the retail and wholesale sectors. Operating within a fast-paced and collaborative environment, the company offers employees the opportunity to play a key role in supporting both customer operations and front-of-house activities.

Your new role
As Administrator / Customer Planner, you will be responsible for processing customer orders and ensuring a smooth flow of communication between customers, sales teams, logistics partners and internal stakeholders. Alongside order management responsibilities, you will also act as the first point of contact for visitors and callers, supporting the day-to-day running of the office and creating a welcoming professional environment.
Key duties will include:
- Processing customer and sample orders accurately and efficiently
- Liaising with logistics providers, customers and sales representatives to ensure timely delivery of goods
- Responding to customer enquiries and providing excellent customer service
- Preparing daily and weekly order reports
- Managing loading sheet administration and supporting order fulfilment processes
- Processing credit note requests and obtaining supporting documentation and approvals
- Providing general administrative support across the business
- Supporting management and sales teams within a small, close-knit administration function
- Managing incoming calls, meeting and greeting visitors, and coordinating hospitality requirements
- Organising meeting rooms and supporting company events and activities
- Coordinating travel and accommodation bookings as required
- Assisting with the organisation of office events and employee engagement activities
- Ensuring office facilities, equipment and supplies are maintained and operating effectively
- Supporting the overall upkeep and presentation of the office environment

What you'll need to succeed
To be considered for this role, you will have:
- A minimum of 1-2 years' experience within order processing, customer planning or a similar administration role
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Strong customer service and communication skills
- The ability to work independently and use initiative
- Experience using ERP systems or order processing software
- Good IT skills and confidence using Microsoft Office applications
- A proactive and collaborative approach to work
- Previous FMCG, retail or wholesale sector experience would be advantageous

What you'll get in return
- Opportunity to join a leading and growing FMCG organisation
- Long-term career development opportunities
- Salary £28k - £30k depending on experience;
- 22 days annual leave plus 11 stat days
- Private Healthcare
- Mon - Thurs 8.30am - 5pm; Friday 8.30am - 4.30pm

What you need to do now

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Executive Assistant - Global Organisation Belfast

Are you an experienced Executive Assistant who enjoys working at the heart of a fast-paced, international business?

Honeycomb is delighted to be partnering with a leading global organisation to recruit an Executive Assistant to support a Senior Vice President within its leadership team.

This is much more than a traditional diary-management role. You will work closely with a highly senior international executive, becoming a trusted point of contact and helping them manage priorities, relationships and commitments across a complex global organisation.

The business has an established and growing presence in Belfast, with teams spanning technology, finance and other key corporate functions. This is an excellent opportunity to join an ambitious international organisation while being based locally in Northern Ireland.

The Role

As Executive Assistant, you will provide high-level, proactive support to the Senior Vice President, helping them operate effectively across a busy international remit.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing a complex and frequently changing executive diary across multiple time zones, ensuring time is aligned to key business priorities.
- Coordinating international and domestic travel, including detailed itineraries, accommodation, logistics and travel documentation.
- Acting as a professional and trusted point of contact for senior stakeholders across the global business.
- Preparing agendas, presentations, briefing materials and documentation for executive and leadership meetings.
- Managing expenses, actions and follow-up from key meetings and commitments.
- Anticipating priorities, identifying potential issues and proactively finding solutions.
- Supporting leadership meetings, corporate events and executive offsites where required.
- Handling sensitive and confidential information with complete discretion.

The Person

We're particularly interested in speaking with experienced Executive Assistants, Senior PAs or executive support professionals who are comfortable operating at senior leadership level.

You'll ideally bring:
- Strong experience supporting a senior executive, ideally at VP, C-Suite or Executive Leadership level.
- Excellent diary and calendar management skills, including coordinating meetings across international time zones.
- Experience arranging complex domestic and international travel.
- Confidence communicating with senior stakeholders and executive teams.
- Exceptional organisation and the ability to manage competing priorities without losing attention to detail.
- A proactive mindset - someone who anticipates what needs to happen rather than waiting to be asked.
- Excellent judgement, professionalism and discretion.
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams and Excel.
- The flexibility required to support a senior leader operating within a global business.

Experience within a global corporate, technology, manufacturing or similarly complex organisation would be advantageous, as would experience in project coordination or organising senior leadership events - but neither is essential.

The Package
- The role offers and excellent base salary + benefits, including:
- Hybrid Working 3 days office, 2 days WFH
- 25 days AL + 10 bank Holidays
- Bonus opportunity
- Private Medical
- Group Life Assurance
- Pension

To Apply

If you are interested in the role, please contact Erin at Honeycomb, or email your CV via the link below.

Should you have a disability and require a reasonable adjustment to be considered at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact Mairead Scott on and we will endeavour to facilitate your request.

title: Executive Assistant
description:

Working in a fast-paced and demanding environment, the postholder will act as a trusted partner, anticipating needs, managing competing priorities, and enabling the Director to focus on organisational objectives.

Executive Support
- Provide proactive, high-quality administrative and executive support to the Director.
- Manage an exceptionally busy and complex diary, ensuring effective prioritisation of appointments, meetings, and commitments.
- Screen, prioritise and manage communications on behalf of the Director.
- Prepare correspondence, presentations, reports, agendas, and briefing papers to a high professional standard.
- Ensure the Director is fully prepared for meetings through comprehensive research and briefing materials.

- Act as a key point of contact for senior internal and external stakeholders.
- Build and maintain effective relationships with executives, board members, partners, and external partners.
- Represent the Director professionally and diplomatically when responding to enquiries.
- Coordinate communications and follow-up actions arising from meetings and discussions.

Meeting & Governance Support
- Organise and coordinate executive meetings, leadership forums, and strategic workshops.
- Prepare meeting packs, agendas, presentations, and supporting documentation.
- Attend meetings where required, taking accurate minutes and tracking actions to completion.
- Ensure governance processes and deadlines are met.

Office & Operational Management

- Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and data protection requirements.

- GCSE English and Maths (Grades A-C) or equivalent plus 2 A Levels or equivalent and 18 months' relevant administrative/clerical experience;
OR
- 3 years' relevant administrative/clerical experience.

Applicants must also have:
- OCR Stage 2 Text Processing/Word Processing or equivalent OR 2 years' experience in high-level word processing.
- Experience supporting a Director, Executive Director, or Senior Leadership Team.
- Proven experience operating successfully in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment.
- Experience managing complex diaries and competing priorities.
- Experience working with highly confidential and sensitive information.
- Demonstrated ability to build relationships with senior stakeholders.

Essential Skills & Competencies
- Highly developed organisational and time management skills.
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Outstanding attention to detail and accuracy.
- Ability to anticipate needs and proactively solve problems.
- High levels of discretion, integrity, and professionalism.
- Decision-making and prioritisation skills.
- Ability to remain calm and effective under pressure.
- Microsoft Office 365 skills, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
- Excellent minute-taking and report-writing abilities.

Personal Attributes
- Demonstrates initiative and accountability.
- Able to respond effectively to changing priorities and business requirements
- Diplomatic and confident when dealing with senior stakeholders.
- Demonstrates professional and effective stakeholder engagement skills
- Able to exercise sound judgement and initiative.
- Committed to delivering excellence and maintaining confidentiality.

Desirable Criteria
- Experience working within a large corporate, public sector, or regulated environment.
- Professional qualifications in business administration, management, or a related field.
- Experience supporting Board or Executive Committee activity.

Additional Information:
- An Access NI Check may be required for this role.

What we can offer you:
- Weekly pay.
- Holiday pay.
- Ongoing support from a dedicated MPA Recruitment Consultant.
- Opportunity to gain valuable experience within a leading public sector organisation.
- Full-time office-based position with regular working hours.
- Potential for contract extension depending on service requirements.

Why Apply?

title: Hub Administrator
description:
Hub Coordinator

A leading and reputable charity based in Belfast, are currently seeking a Hub Coordinator to join their team.

This is a Full-Time, Temporary Position (initially for 1-3 months).

Hours of work: Monday to Friday (with varying shift patterns of 8am - 4pm, 10am - 6pm

With an hourly rate of £12.95 per hour

Job Purpose:

You will be responsible for acting as a first point of contact for all Services across a geographical area from the local coordination Hub. You will lead and support the referral process, co-ordination and booking of care as required, ensuring data and information is accurately inputted into operational and clinical systems. You will work alongside the Senior Co-ordinators in order to ensure the smooth running of the co-ordination hub and will also work alongside and liaise with clinical support & management staff as well as, customers.

Essential Criteria:
- Previous experience within a similar role and of working within a customer service environment.
- IT proficient with the knowledge and use of Microsoft Office Word, Excel, Email and Internet.
- Experience of producing management and statistical reports.
- Excellent communication skills both written and verbal - with the ability to communicate with stakeholders at all levels.
- Ability to manage and prioritise a busy workload.

Main Duties and Responsibilities:
- Maintenance of the daily rota which supports the allocation of staff. This includes responsibility for monitoring and highlighting the utilisation of each service to higher staff and management.
- Confirming changes to rotas directly with staff and managing these changes on the systems.
- Direct liaison/negotiation with staff regarding their ability to cover shifts when they are not on the formal rota.
- Using the Robotic Process Automation system to add referrals into eCommunity and EMIS/SystmOne.
- Input of new customer details to systems ensuring that all key information is accurate and available to the staff.
- Updating information on systems provided by staff as required.
- Communication with customers regarding care provision via telephone. Liaising with referrers to check care packages are in place prior to offering those into care.
- Being responsible for identifying and highlighting rapid discharge and emergency referrals to the Hub Manager & staff.
- Responsibility for ensuring that all the above is clearly documented on Systems so there is no doubt or confusion relating to the status of the care and that all notes are of a high standard to support potential audits.
- Supporting the management of a prioritised caseloads for all services with clinical colleagues.
- Undertaking general administration of the electronic systems, to ensure that accurate records are maintained.
- Coordination of clinical service based on priority and handovers.
- Following discussion with the Senior Coordinator/ Hub Manager allocation of staff to patients.
- Prioritisation to ensure continuity of care and efficient deployment of available staff in line with procedures, standards and processes.
- Calculating the shift and travel time to ensure that staff have minimal down time and optimum numbers of patients receive care.
- Communication regarding confirmation of visits booked.
- Communication with referrers regarding confirmation of visits booked.
